question: The term ‘Shido’ is used in Judo for ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**minor penalty.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shido** is a **minor penalty **in Judo that is given to a player for **breaking minor rules** or **not following the instructions **of the referee.
 
• It is a** warning** to the player to **correct their behavior**, and if they continue to break the rules, they may be given a** more severe penalty.**
 
• Shido is represented by a **small white card**, and a player can receive up to** three Shidos **before being disqualified from the match.
 
• Shido is an important aspect of Judo as it ensures** fair play and discourages players** from **breaking the rules** intentionally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Throwing skill **(Option 2) in Judo is called **Nage-waza**, which includes techniques such as **Osoto-gari, Uchi-mata, and Seoi-nage.**
 
• **Defensive skill** (Option 3) in Judo is called **Katame-waza, **which includes techniques such as **Arm locks, Chokes, and Pinning techniques.**
 
• **Points** (Option 4) in Judo are awarded for** throwing an opponent on their back** or** holding them down** for a certain amount of time. 
 
 
• The player with the **most points** at the end of the match** wins.**
